tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// 'chi med rang gzungs su grags pa sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// ring brgyud/ ༄༅// na mo ā yurde pa ya/ bum pa dang gtor ma sogs spyi ltar bshams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing dwangs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang 'dzum zhing zhi ba yid du 'ong ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na bai ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa'i ral pa phyed thor cog gi tshul du spyi bor bcings shing*/ lhag ma lan bur gyur pas rting pa'i bar du sleb pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'dzoms mdzad pa// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// gzungs ring

a mā ra ṇi/ thung bzla/ 'dod don gsol 'debs bya/ bdag bskyed ltar mdun bskyed bsgrub/ bum bzlas bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs tshar gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs tshar gsum/ slob ma lhar bskyed/ rjes gnang la/ bla ma lha la mos gus byas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ shwa ra re/ ka ra re hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i spyi bo las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus thams cad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa bya/ mgrin pa las 'od zer dmar po byung*/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag 'chi med sogs/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po byung*/ rang gi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag sogs/ slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ bde ba can nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thams cad tshe dpag med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rang la thim par gyur/ sngags brjod/ bum dbang bdag bskyed ltar dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ bskur/ bla ma lha'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim pa'i mos pas lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ mthar 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rang lus sngags phreng hūm̐ dang*/ thig le nā da'i bar du rim bzhin bstims te stong nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag rjes dam tshig khas blang sogs 'dra'o// slar mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul/ dge rtsa bsngo/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol sogs bya'o// sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa'i le'u tshan no//

//sarbā yur+dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // 7 ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
